prior_publication.title: Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I
prior_publication.scope: The paper already identifies and discusses the p199 A supply-message body. The present contribution is the literal source edition, exact deletion/gap alternatives, source-coordinate repairs and conservative unresolved fields. No first historical body decipherment is claimed.
prior_publication.quantity_caveat: The prior prose paraphrase gives approximately ten tons. The unchanged partial square and declared source model here yield1?0; the prior amount is not imported into the source reading.
